article.story: COMMERCE, Texas -- — David Jevtic’s 21 points helped Fairleigh Dickinson defeat East Texas A&M 80-76 in overtime on Wednesday. Jevtic had eight rebounds and three steals for the Knights (2-2). Bol Agu added 18 points while shooting 6 of 9 from the field and 5 for 7 from the line. Alonzo Dodd led the Lions (2-1) in scoring, finishing with 25 points, eight rebounds and five assists. Maxime Carrio added 14 points for East Texas A&M. Mohamed Diakite finished with 10 points, six rebounds and three blocks. Up next Both teams play again on Friday. Fairleigh Dickinson visits Oklahoma and East Texas A&M travels to play Portland. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
